rights_chain_tensions.finding: The current Stanford terms describe site permission as personal and non-transferable and restrict redistribution, while processed derivatives are publicly present in the two author repositories
rights_chain_tensions.why_not_dispositive: The provider page and terms are mutable; historical terms and any separate permissions are unknown; this evidence lane does not adjudicate ownership or legal defenses

rights_chain_tensions.finding: The NGCF MIT license grants rights in Software and associated documentation but does not explicitly identify the Gowalla data as licensed data
Public file links and repository availability are access facts, not affirmative evidence of a complete institutional research-use and redistribution grant
